sources.title: IDEALLab/engiopt-diffusion-2d-cond · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EngiOpt diffusion_2d_cond This repository stores EngiOpt checkpoint packages for one model family. Each checkpoint package contains model weight files together with run_config.json and metadata.json so evaluation can run without depending on W&B run config state.

sources.title: IDEALLab/engiopt-smoke-20260825-211404-diffusion-2d-cond · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EngiOpt diffusion_2d_cond EngiOpt diffusion_2d_cond This repository stores evaluation-ready EngiOpt checkpoints for one model family. The models are trained on EngiBench problem datasets and are intended as learned initializations for downstream engineering optimization. Each package contains model weights, run_config.json, and metadata.json.
